verdict.rationale: A public tax agency website with extensive guidance pages could publish llms.txt or agent-oriented docs, so the axis applies. Direct probes found nothing: llms.txt returned 404, the markdown docs variant returned 404, and every OpenAPI candidate path returned 404. The robots.txt result is an access-control setting, not agent-oriented documentation, and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
